top_signal.title: Small event venue owners - talk some sense into me
top_signal.summary: Or enable me, whichever you think is needed.   I've had this thought for years of talking to my mom, her siblings, and possibly their mother, about taking ownership of my grandparents' house as a bed and breakfast or small event/wedding venue.   A lot of the original idea came from wanting to preserve the house. The house is over 5,500 sq ft on 2.5 acres that, when I was younger, my grandma had lined with gardens, but the yard also hosted many family gatherings and weddings. It is not on a historic registry but does have a historic place marker out front and was the home of one of the main benefactor of the town in the late 1800s. The house was built in 1850. It has a built-in mahogany china cabinet in the formal dining room with carved wooden ceilings, two separate enclosed porches, a grand sweeping staircase with a large crystal chandelier hanging above it. The primary bedroom has "his and hers" bathrooms (granted this is 2 out of the 3.5 in the house). There is an elevator. Despite all of this, due to it's location in the middle of nowhere, it's assessed at just about $500k and based on recent sales in the area, that's probably pretty accurate.   When my grandpa was alive, there was a conversation about how the house would probably be converted into apartments after he and my grandma passed.
